requested_result: Execute a bounded measurement-validity improvement attempt and justify retention or no change, using independent source-contract evidence.

scope_basis.quote: First test measures on fixed artifacts with independently grounded outcome evidence, then test an appropriate bounded skill change.

required_checks.description: Assess indicator uses on fixed artifacts, error types, references and transfer limits.
Run paired skill consumers and execute their actual selected target.
Preserve bounded direct contracts, uncertainty and design-only behavior.
Apply frozen retention rule without manufacturing an improvement claim.
